subject: SupraCloud private offer — rev-share & payment-term exception request
messages:
From: Gabe Turner <gabe.turner@supracloud.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@supracloud.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T08:12:00Z
Subject: Private offer proposal for Redwood — initial draft

Ben —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. SupraCloud is excited to move forward with a private AWS Marketplace offer. Attached is our initial private-offer draft and the RFP schedule. A few headline terms we proposed:

- Rev-share: 18% to Redwood (we proposed higher to account for channel carve and marketplace fees)
- Term: 24 months commitment, automatic renew
- Payment: Net 180 (we have long procurement cycles in enterprise accounts)
- Data / indemnity: we proposed mutual indemnities aligned to our procurement policies (attached redlines)

We know 18% is above your standard marketplace split; we included it to reflect the joint GTM and lead guarantees we discussed (Supra committed $400k in pipeline and introduced two references). Can you confirm if Redwood can accept 18% or what flexibility exists?

Attachments: SupraCloud_PrivateOffer_Draft.pdf, SupraCloud_RFP_Schedule.xlsx

Looking forward — Gabe

Gabe Turner
Head of Partnerships, SupraCloud

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Gabe Turner <gabe.turner@supracloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Private offer proposal for Redwood — initial draft

Gabe,

Thanks for the materials. Quick notes from our side:

- Rev-share: Standard is 12% for AWS private offers; we can make a one-off concession to 15% with a formal joint-marketing commitment and a minimum first-year ARR guarantee of $300k.
- Term: 24 months is fine.
- Payment: Net 180 is outside our preferred terms (we typically accept Net 60 for marketplace listings). We can accept Net 90 for the first year only if Supra provides a purchase order schedule and a credit review.
- Indemnity redlines: forwarding to Legal (CC'd Aditya) for review.

I've attached a short deal economics calc and a redline for the private-offer doc. Let's sync on a next-steps list.

Best,
Ben

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: deal_summary_bencalc.xlsx, redlines_privoffer.docx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T14:20:00Z
Subject: RE: Private offer proposal for Redwood — initial draft

Team,

Legal review highlights:

1) Rev-share at 18% is higher but negotiable. Key ask: require lead/credit evidence clause and a cap on marketplace rebate exposure.
2) Payment Net 180: counterproposal is Net 90 with phased invoicing (30/30/30/10 tied to milestones).
3) Indemnity: Supra's redlines add open-ended vendor indemnities. We must limit to standard mutual indemnities and carve out Redwood's platform telemetry/data usage for auditing purposes only.
4) Term: include a 90-day termination-for-convenience notice after year one.

Recommend escalating to Deal Desk for an exception on the rev-share and to Finance for payment-term exception. I can draft a short memo for exec signoff.

-Aditya (Legal)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T09:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Private offer proposal for Redwood — initial draft

Ben/Aditya,

Finance POV: Net 180 for a new partner is too risky. We can consider Net 90 with an advance deposit equal to 25% of expected first-year ARR, or Net 60 if Supra agrees to PO milestones and a 1.25x credit check covenant. For the rev-share, 15% concession is acceptable if Supra signs the marketing MOU and commits the $300k ARR guarantee in writing (we need signatures).

I'll coordinate with Deal Desk to prepare the exception request package and the P&L sensitivity.

-Laura (Finance)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T18:45:00Z
Subject: Exec approval memo: SupraCloud private-offer exceptions needed

Team,

Attached is the exec memo for signoff. TL;DR:
- Approve rev-share exception to 15% conditional on: signed MOU for joint GTM ($300k first-year ARR guarantee), two enterprise references, and monthly pipeline reports for first 12 months.
- Approve payment-term exception to Net 90 with a 25% upfront deposit and staged invoicing tied to delivery milestones.
- Limit indemnity exposure per Legal redlines; add a marketplace rebate cap at 3% of gross ARR.

Requesting signoff by EOD tomorrow so we can send a counteroffer to Supra and lock their procurement timeline. If Execs prefer, we can elevate to CFO for a one-off Net 180 approval with enhanced credit underwriting (not recommended).

Evelyn Hart
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: exec_memo_supra_privoffer.pdf, financial_sensitivity_tab.xlsx
